services.name: 24/7 Emergency Plumbing
services.description: Around-the-clock emergency plumbing dispatch across Marion, Alachua, and Levy counties. Licensed journeyman on every call. Most calls answered in under two rings and on-site within 40 minutes of the initial call. No extra charge nights, weekends, or holidays.

services.name: Drain Cleaning and Clog Removal
services.description: Mechanical augering, hydrojetting, and video camera inspection for residential and commercial drains. Most single-drain clogs cleared in one visit; stubborn mainline blockages handled with truck-mounted hydrojet equipment. Same-day availability standard.

services.name: Water Heater Repair and Replacement
services.description: Tank and tankless water heater repair, replacement, and gas-to-electric conversions. Most residential water heater replacements complete in one day. We stock A.O. Smith and Rinnai units on the trucks for fastest turnaround.

services.name: Pipe Repair and Leak Detection
services.description: Acoustic leak detection, pinhole repair, and slab-leak diagnosis without destructive exploratory demolition. We find the leak before we open the wall. Most residential repairs finish in under four hours.

services.name: Full Re-pipe Service
services.description: Whole-home re-pipe in PEX or copper, including permit pulling, wall opening and patching coordination, and fixture protection. Typical single-family re-pipe completes in three to five days with water service restored nightly.

services.name: Backflow Prevention and Testing
services.description: Annual backflow preventer testing and certification for commercial accounts and irrigation systems per AWWA and Florida Department of Health requirements. Certified testers on staff; reports filed directly with the water authority on your behalf.

serviceAreaRegion: Central Florida — Marion, Alachua, Levy, and northern Citrus counties. 24-hour emergency radius extends into Sumter County.

featuredPromotion.text: $0 after-hours trip charge — you pay the same at 3am as at 3pm.

guarantees.type: licensed journeyman on every emergency call
guarantees.source: home page hero + About page + multiple Google reviews
